title: GitHub now blocks Anthropic API keys during protected pushes
friendlyTitle: GitHub can stop Anthropic keys from being pushed into code
summary: GitHub secret scanning can now detect Anthropic service and user API keys, Cloudsmith API keys and a Salesforce Marketing Cloud token type. Repositories with secret scanning enabled will block pushes containing Anthropic keys by default, including eligible free public repositories.
friendlySummary: GitHub now detects more secret keys. When protection is enabled, it can block a commit that contains an Anthropic API key.
whyItMatters: Leaked model credentials can create immediate data and cost exposure, particularly in agentic applications that call tools. Push protection adds a useful last line of defence, but teams should still keep secrets out of source files, limit key privileges and rotate exposed credentials promptly.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A leaked AI key can expose data or create a large bill. Keep keys outside your code and replace them quickly if they leak.
